issue:339.decision: already_hardened_keep_stale_calls_rejected: The latest evidence shows server-side generations can continue after ChatGPT displays an error, and upstream 5.0.8 automatically retried six submitted attempts, multiplying retired claims. Local code disables automatic replay once submission began, retains exact sessions across observer reconnects, and retires capabilities only after physical browser settlement plus admitted observer tails. A delayed call after proven terminal retirement must still be rejected; reactivating its token could execute stale side effects.
issue:339.scopeNote: A remote generation may still attempt a connector call after the browser reports a terminal provider error; local code can reject it but cannot prove or cancel ChatGPT's server-side generation from this evidence. No live provider fault injection was performed in this lane.

pull:604.decision: reject_current_patch_requires_coordinated_endpoint_lock_protocol: The reported Bun behavior is applicable: local close checks its recorded inode only after Server.close(), so an old server can unlink a newer listener at the same pathname. PR 604's park-and-restore algorithm is nevertheless unsafe to port. Parking races pathname replacement, waiting for close can make the replacement unreachable behind an old accepted connection, and exists-then-rename restoration can overwrite a newer replacement B. The attempted local adaptation was removed after independent counter-review. Existing inode-checked cleanup remains unchanged because it is stronger than importing a known displacement race, although it does not solve Bun's close-time unlink.
pull:604.scopeNote: The applicable Bun close-time unlink remains unresolved in this lane. Adding a lock only to this close path would not serialize an older or newer process whose start path does not acquire the same lock. An externally replaced endpoint may be owned by a process outside the local in-memory broker registry; pathname existence and inode observation alone do not authorize parking or restoration. No portable no-overwrite Unix-socket restoration primitive was established here; symlink/hard-link socket behavior was not assumed or tested. No broker source or broker regression test remains from the rejected adaptation.

pull:601.decision: adapted_with_native_rollout_authority: The local direct environment walker had the same adjacency gap for both observed Codex 0.155 compaction shapes. The adaptation is placed in the canonical thread-environment owner: it projects only the two exact message layouts into the existing metadata/sandbox parser, then accepts the claim only when the current native rollout proves the same thread, turn, cwd, roots, writable roots, and sandbox authority. Nonempty item IDs are structural bounds only and grant no authority.
pull:601.scopeNote: The focused regression was written but not executed by this lane. The lower-level environment extractor remains unchanged; the fix applies through ChatGptThreadEnvironmentStore, which is the adapter's canonical environment owner. The projection accepts only message layouts containing exactly one environment envelope and at least one recognized native compaction summary; it does not implement PR 568 pathless cached-authority fallback or the unreviewed post-close delta. A current native rollout is mandatory; an unavailable rollout remains a terminal missing-environment result.
